title: Polite Requests & Offers (Could, Can, Will, Would, Let me, I'll)

topics.name: Requests with Could/Can/Will/Would
topics.rule: لطلب شيء بأدب نستخدم Could you / Can you / Will you / Would you + مصدر بدون to.
examples: Will you send me an email?

topics.name: Offers and Promises
topics.rule: Let me + مصدر (للسماح بعرض المساعدة). I'll (I will) + مصدر (للوعد أو العرض).

topics.name: Verb + Object + to + Infinitive
topics.rule: بعد أفعال مثل want, ask, tell نستخدم: فعل + مفعول + to + مصدر.
examples: I want you to make your bed.
